About the Role

Join an early-stage sales team at a data and infrastructure company, working with sales leadership to turn technical interest into commercial opportunities. You will learn the full sales process while helping build repeatable ways to engage engineering teams and prospective customers.

What You'll Do

  • Identify prospective customers through product adoption, community participation, cloud sign-ups, and other intent signals.

  • Research organizations, engineering teams, technology stacks, and potential use cases.

  • Conduct personalized outreach across email, LinkedIn, Slack, and other channels to generate qualified opportunities.

  • Participate in discovery calls, technical evaluations, product demonstrations, and commercial negotiations.

  • Gradually manage smaller accounts through the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to contract execution.

  • Work with solutions architects and engineers to understand customer requirements and support evaluations.

  • Test prospecting strategies, messaging, tools, and channels, and help build sales processes and playbooks.

  • Share customer feedback with product and engineering teams.

What We're Looking For

  • Zero to two years of professional experience, or a final-year student or recent graduate.

  • Internship or job experience in B2B SaaS sales, business development, or a customer-facing technical role.

  • Familiarity with databases, cloud computing, data infrastructure, or developer tools.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, curiosity about software, and the ability to ask thoughtful questions.

  • Initiative, organization, resourcefulness, and a coachable mindset in an environment where processes are still developing.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary is $60,000 to $80,000 annually, with approximately $120,000 to $160,000 OTE (on-target earnings, base plus variable). The target compensation split is approximately 50/50 base and variable.

Location

On-site. The primary location was not specified.

Compensation Range: $60K - $80K
